title: A String Avoiding Every Bad Event
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, and let $\mathrm{Bad}(v,w)$ be a predicate on an $n$-bit string $v$ and a bit string $w$. Suppose that for every $v$, the fraction of the $2^m$ bit strings $w$ of length $m$ for which $\mathrm{Bad}(v,w)$ holds is at most $\delta$, and that $2^n\delta<1$. Then there is an $m$-bit string $w$ for which $\mathrm{Bad}(v,w)$ fails for every $n$-bit string $v$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $n$-bit string, the fraction of bad $m$-bit strings is at most $\delta$
